logic.dockDefault: clamp(120, min(400, max(276, 0.38 * stageHeight)), stageHeight - 166); a stored ws.dock.flight wins; until the user drags, the default follows the stage through a ResizeObserver

logic.readoutCompactRule: canvas w < 700 || h < 420 -> full-width strip sharing the bottom band with the scrubber; otherwise the floating card
logic.readoutCompactWhy: on a 636 px canvas the widest tilted pose reaches under the floating card and the camera does not refit on a pose change; the bottom band also returns ~22 px of region versus a separate top strip
